scope: Local offline preparation orchestration using supplied audit responses and disposable files; no compiled genesis or chain execution
change: Bind all five policy objects exposed by the pinned v2 auditor between the budget probe and final genesis, before copying the launch bundle or running either replay.

validation.skipReason: Existing Linux-only process-name truncation check on a non-Linux development host.

preFixRun.basis: Two epoch-schedule mutations and three false-for-zero substitutions reached prepared. Six other malformed policy cases failed only in later validation, after replay, instead of the required pre-copy policy admission.

checks: Fifteen final-report mutation cases reject changed or missing objects, boolean substitutions and policy drift with unchanged burn/initial-inflation fields.
Refusals retain the failed attempt and partial compiler output without a bundle genesis, manifest or ledger-tool invocation.
All five policy objects must be nonempty JSON objects. Non-finite values refuse; key ordering does not affect comparison.
The unchanged synthetic driver still calibrates once, selects the exact numeric hash count and completes two separate replay copies.

limitations: Supplied reports are not proof of real compiler, auditor, ledger-tool or validator execution.
Only the five policy objects emitted by the pinned v2 auditor are compared; unexposed GenesisConfig fields and all account bytes remain separate requirements.
This checks equality to the probe, not complete independent policy-schema validation. Existing final supply and policy admission remains required.
Reserve-byte adapter integration, fresh compiled genesis, two real strict replays, suitable Linux hosting, independent operators and funded backing remain open.
